name: compute_budget
docs: The Compute Budget program: transaction-wide compute unit limit, priority fee, heap frame and loaded account data size.

instructions.name: requestHeapFrame
docs: Request a specific transaction-wide program heap region size in bytes, a multiple of 1024.

instructions.name: setComputeUnitLimit
docs: Set a specific compute unit limit that the transaction is allowed to consume.

instructions.name: setComputeUnitPrice
docs: Set a compute unit price in micro-lamports to pay a higher transaction fee for higher transaction prioritization.

instructions.name: setLoadedAccountsDataSizeLimit
docs: Set a specific transaction-wide account data size limit, in bytes, that is allowed to load.
